review_candidates.title: Customer Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The KLA Services team headquartered in Milpitas, CA is our service organization that consists of Service Sales and Marketing, Spares Supply Chain management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, and Technical Support. The KLA Services organization partners with our field teams and customers in all business sectors to maintain the high performance and productivity of our products through a flexible portfolio of services. Our comprehensive services include: proactive management of tools to identify and improve performance; expertise in optics, image processing and motion control with worldwide service engineers, 24/7 technical support teams and knowledge management systems; and an extensive parts network to ensure worldwide availability of parts. Job Description/Preferred Qualifications General Description: Primarily responsible for customer service activities associated with updating, troubleshooting, diagnosing and repairing of highly complex capital equipment at customer sites and trade shows. Represents the company to the customer and assumes accountability for customer satisfaction with service. Assures operational quality of system equipment. Coordinates actions with customers to minimize down time. Provides assistance to Installation Engineers and less experienced CSEs in resolving problems. A CSE providing service support for customer Micron Technology, Inc. in Boise, ID. The CSE is responsible for providing tool repair, customer management, and performing all associated logistics tasks. The CSE must have good troubleshooting skills and be proficient in working on electro-mechanical equipment within a cleanroom environment. The CSE must be self-motivated and driven to provide the best support for KLA customers. The CSE must demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills as communication with customers, co-workers, and management is critical to the role. Primary Responsibilities: Provide customer service support a variety of advanced KLA products. Be the primary focal point of contact for all customer service-related issues. Maintain excellent working relationship with customers, CSEs, applications engineers, technical support and sales teams. Evaluate, analyze, diagnose and troubleshoot technical equipment problems at customer site. Assists customers with all system issues. Ensures equipment enhances customer production. Maintain Preventive Maintenance schedule on KLA tools at customer sites and execute on all PMs per the schedule. Repair and update equipment at customer site, including system level problems (which have multiple causes and for which no standard procedures exist) based on CSE’s technical knowledge, education, training and certification. May access and determine the problems existing in customers’ processes such as chemical leaks or contamination, and as a result may recommend shutdown of a customer fab due to unsafe conditions. Prepare Field Service Reports on customer support activity and provides documentation to other supporting functions on recurring problems. Create service reports for all service requests using the CRM database. Cross-train and assist other field service engineers as needed. Assist Tech Support on all onsite system escalations. Provide first level Applications support. Provide guidance and technical assistance to Installation Engineers on installations and dismantling equipment. Provide guidance to less senior CSEs. Manage individual inventory account. Assist in the preparation of quotes for customers based on labor, travel expenses incurred, and parts needed. Uses discretion and assist regional admin in preparing quotes based on reason for equipment failure, time to prepare, etc. Conduct customer orientation and technical training on all aspects of equipment maintenance support for user applications. Contribute to the capturing, re-use, collaboration, and improvement of knowledge using available systems. Successfully complete ongoing technical training to acquire a thorough knowledge of company products, the application of diagnostic techniques, and practical application of service aids. Cross-train on multiple products. Attain and maintain at least Certification Level 3 or PM training. Attain and maintain basic proficiency in systems level repair of a product within a family is required. Skills Needed: Understanding of and ability to troubleshoot problems in software and electronics, optics, mechanical, electro-mechanical and electro-optical systems. Understanding of computer theory, various operating systems and applicable operating system software knowledge, and networking in a Windows, Unix or Novell environment. Good interpersonal/communication skills in understanding customer needs. Ability to work under pressure and stringent timelines since systems down for service may affect customer manufacturing area. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience Base Pay Range: $33.75 - $57.36 Per Hour Primary Location: USA-ID-Boise-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at +1-408-352-2808 to request accommodation. Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Develop development scenarios (land-use mix, product mix, unit sizes, phasing, construction cost and timeline) using inputs from Design & Development and Project Management. Benchmark the market and competitors on pricing, payment plans, absorption rates and product offering to support the business case. Prepare investment papers and presentations for management, stating returns, risks, sensitivities and a clear recommendation. Build and maintain detailed project-level development financial models using agreed structures, assumptions and accounting treatment. Calculate and monitor investment indicators: IRR, NPV, gross and net margins, payback period and peak funding requirement. Run sensitivity and scenario analysis on selling prices, cost escalation, inflation, FX, sales velocity and collection rates. Prepare the five-year business plan for the destinations, covering launches, sales, collections, construction spend, deliveries and cash flow. Work with different departments to keep the plan aligned with the development pipeline, construction schedules and sales targets and highlight any deviations from the approved plan. Support in the development of annual budget and periodic re-forecasts. Assess the impact of payment plans and discounts on NPV and cash flow to support approval decisions. Monitor sales performance and market movements, and propose price revisions to protect margins and absorption. Track actual project performance (sales, achieved prices, costs, cash flow) against the approved feasibility study and business plan. Issue the monthly project performance pack and dashboards for management, and lead post-launch reviews that feed lessons into future studies. Define and maintain the project KPIs and recommend corrective actions when results drift from plan. Keep one approved, version-controlled set of models and assumptions, and protect the confidentiality of commercial information. Automate recurring reports with advanced Excel, and document methods, templates and review controls so outputs are consistent and auditable. Proven experience in master-planned or mixed-use developments in Egypt, including pricing and payment-plan design for off-plan sales. Experience supervising or reviewing the work of analysts. Track record of presenting analysis to senior management. Advanced Excel financial modelling (DCF, IRR, NPV, scenario and sensitivity analysis).

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Serval is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations. At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering. Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving. We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. Role Overview Serval is building an AI platform to automate complex IT workflows for modern enterprises. As a Software Engineer, Infrastructure, you'll build and scale the foundational systems that power Serval's AI agents and workflow automation platform. A critical part of this role is enabling and supporting self-hosted deployments for enterprise customers who require on-premises or private cloud installations. This role is for engineers with deep expertise in distributed systems, infrastructure-as-code, production operations, and customer-facing infrastructure support who want to shape the technical architecture of a fast-growing platform. What You'll Do Design, implement, and operate large-scale distributed systems that power Serval's AI agents, workflow orchestration, and data pipelines. Write and maintain Terraform modules to provision and manage cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure environments. Build and maintain deployment packages, installation scripts, and infrastructure templates that enable customers to self-host Serval in their own environments. Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to enterprise customers deploying and operating self-hosted instances of Serval. Ensure high availability, performance, and reliability of production systems through monitoring, alerting, incident response, and capacity planning. Build internal tools and platforms that enable product engineers to deploy, test, and operate services efficiently. The Product Lead leads one or more product managers and owns a part of the business verticals within the Ops tribe. Under this umbrella, the Product Lead collaborates with more than one squad and is accountable for the product results across them. This is a role built around the hubs. The Product Lead is on the hub floor at least twice a week, understands how parcels, couriers and hub teams actually work, and turns what they see into clear product decisions. The first question is always whether a process change solves the problem; a tech solution comes only when it does not. The role also covers hubs outside Cairo & Giza, in the Delta and Upper Egypt, where cut-off times and operations flows differ and the product has to fit how each hub runs. The Product Lead has to deliver focused impact across several scopes at the same time, and has to speak the same language as the operations people who use the products every day. Job Description Lead one or more product managers in the Operations tribe, setting priorities, coaching them, and owning the product results of the part of the business verticals assigned to the Product Lead. Collaborate with more than one squad under this umbrella, keeping their roadmaps aligned to shared operational objectives and resolving overlaps and dependencies between them. Be on the hub floor at least twice a week to watch operations first-hand, talk to hub teams, and find where the current process or product slows them down. Travel to hubs outside Cairo & Giza, including the Delta and Upper Egypt, to understand and productize operations that run on different cut-off times and operational flows from the Cairo & Giza hubs. Optimize the process before building anything. Review how work is done on the ground and fix the process first; commission a tech solution only when a process change cannot deliver the result. Translate on-ground challenges into clear problem statements and product solutions, and discuss them with operations teams in their own language, using their terms and their metrics instead of product jargon. Prioritize and balance work across several scopes at the same time, keeping each squad focused and making sure each scope delivers measurable impact. Review the quality of discovery, solution design and delivery by the PMs, and follow each release through to hub adoption, measuring it against the operational metrics agreed with operations teams. Align priorities and trade-offs with operations leadership, engineering and design, and report progress and results to the Head of Product, Operations. Required: Able to commit to hub visits at least twice a week. Open to traveling outside Cairo & Giza to the Delta and Upper Egypt hubs, which have different cut-off times and operational flows that need to be productized. Knows how to optimize processes and does not treat a tech solution as the first answer. Knows how to translate on-ground challenges into product solutions, and can talk in the same language as on-ground people. Able to focus and create impact in multiple scopes at the same time, including working with more than one squad. Experience in logistics or supply chain is preferred. Responsibilities: Identify, target, and acquire new corporate clients requiring HR outsourcing and related HR solutions. Develop and execute effective business development strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets. Generate new enterprise opportunities Build and maintain C-level and key stakeholder relationships Develop outsourcing and staffing opportunities Generate leads through networking, referrals, LinkedIn, industry events, cold outreach, partnerships, and other channels. Own the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through proposal, negotiation, closing, and handover. Understand clients’ HR challenges and business requirements and recommend appropriate outsourcing solutions. Navigate complex enterprise procurement processes Build a strong pipeline and consistently achieve revenue targets Lead commercial negotiations and successfully close complex B2B deals.     Requirements: • 5–7+ years of experience in B2B / Enterprise Sales • Mandatory: Proven experience selling Outsourcing / Managed Services in the Saudi market • Strong understanding of the Saudi enterprise market and decision-making processes • Proven experience dealing with Enterprise, Banking, Insurance, and Fintech clients • Strong existing network and connections within the KSA market • Established relationships with IT, Procurement, HR, and business decision-makers • Strong connections with Procurement and IT departments to identify opportunities and drive the sales cycle • Proven ability to generate new business, open enterprise accounts, and manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing • Experience selling Staff Augmentation, Recruitment, IT Outsourcing, Managed Services, or similar outsourcing solutions • Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship-building skills • Experience working with CRM platforms and maintaining accurate sales pipelines • Strong knowledge of the competitive landscape and outsourcing trends in Saudi Arabia

review_candidates.title: Salesperson
review_candidates.location: Al Maḩallah al Kubrá, Al Gharbiyah, Egypt
review_candidates.description: Company Description urca erp is a growing provider of enterprise resource planning (ERP) solutions designed to help organizations streamline operations and improve decision-making. The company focuses on delivering practical, user-friendly tools that connect core business functions such as finance, sales, and inventory management. urca erp values collaboration, continuous learning, and customer satisfaction, offering team members opportunities to contribute directly to product and process improvements. Joining urca erp means working in an environment that encourages initiative, supports professional development, and embraces technology-driven innovation. Role Description This is a full-time hybrid Salesperson role based in Al Maḩallah al Kubrá, with the flexibility to perform some tasks from home. The Salesperson will identify and qualify leads, conduct product demonstrations, and present ERP solutions to prospective clients. Daily responsibilities include managing a sales pipeline, preparing proposals and quotations, following up on opportunities, and negotiating terms to close deals. The role involves maintaining strong relationships with existing customers, gathering feedback, and collaborating with the implementation and support teams to ensure client satisfaction. The Salesperson will also track sales metrics, report on performance, and contribute ideas to improve sales processes and go-to-market strategies. Qualifications Experience in B2B sales, preferably with software, technology, or ERP solutions, and a proven ability to meet or exceed sales targets. Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in clear, business-focused language. Comfort with CRM tools, basic analytics, and structured sales processes, including pipeline management and forecasting. Ability to build and maintain long-term customer relationships, handle objections, and adapt to different stakeholder needs. Self-motivated, organized, and able to work effectively in a hybrid setup, balancing on-site client visits with remote work. Good understanding of general business operations; familiarity with ERP or business management systems is a strong advantage. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Proficiency in relevant languages for the local market and comfort working in a multicultural, inclusive environment.

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer (DevOps), TIC
review_candidates.description: GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity. At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round. Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today! Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg. [What you will be working on] As a Software Engineer, you will take on meaningful ownership of features and technical work that spans multiple components of our products. You will work with a degree of independence while continuing to grow through mentorship, and you will play an active role in shaping the quality, reliability, and culture of the team you work in. Craft & Execution You will deliver features and proofs of concept that span multiple components or modules, typically working across two to three areas within your team. While you will receive mentorship on architectural decisions and cross-component integration, you are expected to make thoughtful trade-offs between performance, security, and maintainability based on your understanding of the context. You will write and review code with clarity and long-term maintainability in mind, applying good engineering practices consistently, and you will expand test coverage — including unit and integration tests — to support key workflows and reduce flakiness. Beyond feature delivery, you are responsible for the team's CI/CD processes and deployment pipelines; and will address pockets of technical debt within your domain, suggest improvements that enhance product performance or team velocity. You will also take a deliberate approach to balancing short-term delivery speed with long-term code health, flagging when quick fixes introduce future risk, and applying organisational platform and compliance standards effectively. After your work ships, you are expected to follow through on its impact — checking metrics, reviewing error rates, and addressing post-deployment issues proactively. You will actively participate in incident triage and resolution with team support, and escalate complex issues when needed. You will also bring rigour to the use of AI-generated code, reviewing it for correctness, edge cases, security issues, and maintainability to the same standard as any human-authored contribution. Writing clear task descriptions and specifications to get higher-quality AI assistance and reduce rework is part of how you work. Ownership You will independently own your assigned tasks and projects, identifying and addressing issues proactively with minimal guidance. You will know when to seek help and from whom, and you will look for opportunities to recommend improvements to processes or outcomes within your own work. Strategic Alignment You will align your work with your team's goals and priorities, focusing on tasks that deliver the most expected business value. You will adapt to changing priorities independently, without needing to be redirected. Culture and Organisational Influence You will collaborate with peers and stakeholders to ensure work is executed effectively, address minor conflicts constructively and respectfully, and suggest improvements that enhance team effectiveness. You will share knowledge, resources, successes, and failures openly — because you understand that team success depends on everyone having the information they need. [What we are looking for] Experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in Software Engineering and DevOps/cloud infrastructure roles. Proven track record building scalable cloud platforms or shared infrastructure. Experience driving cross-team engineering standards or platform adoption. Bonus: Prior experience working on Government projects on GCC. Technical Skills Strong proficiency with cloud platforms such as AWS (key), Azure, or Google Cloud. Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, and networking/security.. Expertise in Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform and containerization technologies such as Docker. Experience with CI/CD systems, observability stacks, and SRE practices. Familiarity with Node.js, TypeScript, and modern development practices Please note that this will be a 2-year fixed tern contract. What we offer you: GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe that diversity is the foundation to innovation. Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks. These include leave benefits to meet your work-life needs and employee wellness programs. We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust that you will manage your own time to deliver your best, wherever you are, and whatever works best for you. Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers. Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

review_candidates.title: Senior Python Backend Engineer – A2A & AWS AgentCore
review_candidates.description: Senior Python Backend Engineer – A2A & AWS AgentCore Location: Remote / Global Engagement: Staff Augmentation through Intellias Department: Core Architecture / Digital Engineering Platform Degree: Bachelor’s Degree Experience: 5+ years About the Role We are looking for a Senior Python Backend Engineer to build and integrate agent-to-agent (A2A) communication capabilities on AWS AgentCore platforms. The role focuses on Python backend development, A2A protocol implementation, agent discovery and registration, event-driven communication, and scalable multi-agent interactions . The ideal candidate has strong backend engineering experience, expertise in asynchronous systems, and hands-on knowledge of modern API and agent integration patterns. You will join the Core Architecture Team and help build the foundations for a scalable enterprise multi-agent ecosystem, enabling AI agents and services to discover, communicate with, and securely invoke one another. Project Overview Our customer is a multinational corporation with more than a century of history, operating in 180+ countries and serving more than 1 billion consumers worldwide . The organization is undertaking a major transformation focused on introducing a new generation of Reduced-Risk Products (RRPs) and developing an innovative digital ecosystem around IoT, eCommerce, and digital marketing. Its IT platform hosts 700+ applications , creating a complex environment in which scalable, secure, and standardized engineering capabilities are essential. Intellias supports the engineering of a comprehensive software ecosystem for a game-changing IoT product at the intersection of innovative consumer experiences and cutting-edge technology. As a Senior Python Backend Engineer, you will become part of the Core Architecture Team , contributing to the architecture and implementation of best practices across the Digital Engineering Enterprise Platform. The platform provides engineering teams with reusable services, technologies, and practices that accelerate software development and operations while addressing common SDLC challenges and ensuring compliance and security. Key Responsibilities Backend & AgentCore Development Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Python and the AWS AgentCore SDK . Build and maintain A2A integrations using AWS AgentCore Runtime and Gateway . Implement agent registration, target configuration, and discovery workflows. Develop reliable backend services for distributed multi-agent environments. Design APIs and routing mechanisms that enable seamless communication between agents and enterprise services. A2A Protocol Implementation Implement A2A communication patterns between caller and target agents. Work with the A2A protocol wire format, including: JSON-RPC 2.0 SSE task lifecycle events Push notifications Implement agent invocation workflows and communication templates. Develop and maintain Agent Card definitions. Implement and maintain the /.well-known/agent.json endpoint for agent discovery. Ensure Agent Card schemas accurately describe agent capabilities, endpoints, and interaction requirements. Asynchronous & Event-Driven Communication Design asynchronous communication flows using Server-Sent Events (SSE), webhooks, and push notifications . Implement task lifecycle handling and status tracking. Build event-driven mechanisms for monitoring agent execution and communication. Support reliable communication across distributed agents and services. Handle asynchronous failures, retries, timeouts, and other distributed-system concerns. API & Integration Engineering Design and implement REST APIs , including building and maintaining production endpoints. Develop API routing and integration patterns for agent-to-agent communication. Implement secure and reliable service-to-service interactions. Integrate agents with enterprise platforms and supporting services. Ensure API contracts and integration patterns are consistent, maintainable, and scalable. Scalability, Security & Reliability Design secure communication mechanisms between distributed agents and services. Optimize backend services for performance, reliability, and scalability. Implement appropriate error handling, monitoring, and operational controls. Troubleshoot production and integration issues. Conduct testing and validation of agent communication workflows. Contribute to architecture decisions and engineering best practices. Collaboration & Documentation Collaborate with AI, platform, architecture, and security teams to support the enterprise multi-agent ecosystem. Work with technical stakeholders to define integration requirements and connectivity patterns. Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and architecture reviews. Produce technical documentation covering APIs, integration standards, Agent Cards, and agent connectivity patterns. Contribute to continuous improvement of the enterprise agent platform. Required Qualifications & Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 5+ years of professional experience in Python or Go backend engineering. Strong hands-on experience with Python , particularly asynchronous programming. Experience with REST API implementation , including building production endpoints rather than only consuming APIs. Experience with API integration and routing . Strong understanding of agent-to-agent or microservice communication patterns . Experience with asynchronous and event-driven communication patterns such as: SSE Webhooks Event-driven APIs Experience designing and implementing scalable backend services. Understanding of distributed systems and service-to-service communication. Strong understanding of API contracts, JSON-based communication, and integration patterns. Ability to troubleshoot complex distributed backend and integration issues. Strong English communication and collaboration skills. AWS & A2A Technical Requirements Hands-on experience with the following is strongly preferred: AWS AgentCore Runtime AWS AgentCore Gateway Agent registration and target configuration Agent discovery Agent Card JSON schema /.well-known/agent.json endpoint implementation A2A protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 SSE-based task lifecycle events Push notifications Caller and target agent invocation patterns Python AgentCore SDK REST-based agent integrations Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience validating AWS AgentCore Gateway template integrations . Experience with AWS Bedrock multi-agent invocation patterns . Hands-on experience implementing SSE event streaming , including task lifecycle events and push notifications. Experience with OpenTelemetry trace propagation across A2A agent hops . Familiarity with AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) . Experience with AI agent platforms and multi-agent architectures. Experience with cloud-native and serverless architectures on AWS. Experience with API gateways, service discovery, and distributed routing. Experience working in large enterprise technology environments. Key Technical Skills Python | AWS AgentCore | AgentCore Runtime | AgentCore Gateway | A2A Protocol | Agent-to-Agent Communication | REST APIs | JSON-RPC 2.0 | SSE | Webhooks | Agent Cards | Agent Discovery | Async Python | Event-Driven Architecture | API Integration | Backend Engineering | Distributed Systems | AWS Bedrock | OpenTelemetry Why This Position? Work at the forefront of AI engineering: Build infrastructure enabling AI agents to communicate and collaborate autonomously. Build enterprise-scale multi-agent capabilities: Contribute to a platform designed to support secure and scalable agent-to-agent interactions. Cutting-edge AWS technology: Gain hands-on experience with AWS AgentCore and emerging agent interoperability patterns. Architecture impact: Join the Core Architecture Team and influence standards for enterprise agent connectivity and integration. Global scale: Contribute to technology supporting an organization with 700+ applications across 180+ countries . Innovation-focused environment: Work at the intersection of AI, IoT, cloud engineering, and digital transformation. Meaningful technical challenges: Solve complex problems involving distributed systems, asynchronous communication, agent discovery, routing, and event-driven architectures. Intellias partnership: Join through Intellias and contribute to a major global technology transformation. Education Bachelor’s degree in computer science , Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
